name: Rotten Life: Desert Prisoner
detailed_description:
About "Làn Mìng" (Rotten Life)

Developer's Note
We are Opportunity Cat Research Institute (Orange Cat Studio) - a small team consisting of just two passionate game enthusiasts.
"Làn Mìng" is our debut work, carrying all our obsession with "authentic medieval combat." Though currently still a fledgling Demo, every sword swing's feedback and every enemy AI's roar have been meticulously polished. We look forward to your participation in testing, using your sharpest criticisms to help us temper this iron blade.

Core Game Features

▸ Hardcore Side-scrolling Action × Roguelike Adventure

Classic arcade-style controls focused on realistic combat system:
Sparks from blade collisions, staggering when wounded, weight differences between weapons... Every detail aims to recreate the immersion of "dancing on the edge of a blade"

Rejecting flashy special effects, using realistic limb destruction mechanics and hit feedback to make every battle feel like a life-or-death gamble

▸ Brutal Mercenary Survival Simulation

Play as a bottom-tier mercenary crushed by war, traversing a vivid medieval continent

In settings like plague villages, fallen castles, and cursed dungeons, use bounties to upgrade equipment or learn more powerful moves

▸ Explore Dark Underground Worlds (In Development)

Current Demo version includes: 4 main weapon styles / freely customizable combo system

Full version will add: rich random events / mechanical traps and puzzles / legendary Boss battles (your feedback will directly influence development priorities!)

short_description: "Rotten Life" is a dark medieval RPG where you play a desperate mercenary. Complete lethal contracts, explore cursed dungeons, and manipulate warring factions. In this brutal world, survival means getting your hands dirty. No heroes - just blood, gold, and hard choices.
